latest_release.body:
1. 修复 64g 及以上引导盘 p3 分区没有自动扩容的问题.
2. 修复 克隆引导盘对 64g 及以上磁盘和 emmc 磁盘的兼容性问题.
3. 更新 hdddb 插件, 版本升级至 v3.6.139. Thanks @007revad.
4. 更新 cpuinfo 插件, 修复对 NVIDIA 计算卡的支持.
5. 更新 r8168, r8126, yt6801, ch35x_38x, igc(#33782, Thanks @llzg) 驱动.
6. 其他.

----

1. Fixed the issue of p3 partition not automatically expanding on boot disks of 64g and above.
2. Fixed the compatibility issue of cloning boot disks with 64g and above disks and emmc disks.
3. Updated hdddb addon, version to v3.6.139. Thanks @007revad.
4. Updated cpuinfo addon, fixed the support for NVIDIA compute cards.
5. Updated r8168, r8126, yt6801, ch35x_38x, igc(#33782, Thanks @llzg) drivers.
6. Other.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/RROrg/rr/compare/26.8.2...26.9.0
